about.title: About Us
about.description: Táxi Map is a technology platform developed by MURA, dedicated to transforming urban mobility through technology.
about.mission: To make public and private transport more accessible, organized, safe, and efficient for passengers, taxi operators, and companies.
about.footer: We create digital solutions that bring people, companies, and transport service providers together.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be the leading mobility technology platform in Angola and a reference in Africa for digitalizing urban transport.

challenges.title: Urban Mobility Challenges in Angola
individualsItems: Difficulty identifying the correct route to reach the destination.
Lack of clear information about routes and boarding points.
Uncertainty about which taxis pass through a given location.
Reliance on third parties to obtain route information.
Low confidence when traveling to unfamiliar places.
businessesItems: Difficulty monitoring operations in real time.
Lack of indicators and reports to support decisions.
Low level of digitalization of operational processes.
challenges.conclusion: Táxi Map connects these two needs through technology.
